verdict.rationale: Cekura documents its own rule-driven automation, but only in narrow forms. Structured Test evaluators support conditional actions: rule-based behavior that responds when the agent says specific things during a conversation. Cron jobs run automated calls on a schedule and alert you when they fail. Neither amounts to a general user-defined event→action rule engine; the GitHub Actions trigger runs on the host platform and earns no credit. Missing for 10: a general automation/rules engine over production events (e.g., metric threshold breach → custom action), configurable outbound actions or webhooks on events, and independent corroboration.
